steps.en: Start the pinned Miles container on an 8-GPU node
steps.zh: 在 8 卡节点上启动锁版本的 Miles 容器

steps.en: Convert the HuggingFace weights once into Megatron's sharded format
steps.zh: 把 HF 权重一次性转成 Megatron 分片格式

steps.en: Launch the model's recipe script; plug in your own reward if needed
steps.zh: 运行该模型的配方脚本，需要时接入自定义奖励

steps.en: Starts Ray; SGLang engines generate and score several answers per prompt
steps.zh: 拉起 Ray，SGLang 引擎对每个提示生成并打分多个答案

steps.en: Megatron takes a GRPO step on the same tokens and expert routes
steps.zh: Megatron 在同样的 token 与专家路由上走一步 GRPO

steps.en: Syncs new weights into the engines, checkpoints, and loops again
steps.zh: 把新权重同步回引擎、存 checkpoint，然后下一轮

value.en: A live RL run on a large model where rollout and training stay in step — no weight-sync or tokenizer glue to write
value.zh: 大模型 RL 跑起来且训推对齐，不用自己写权重同步和切词胶水
